# Lucas Coco

> AI Product / Full Stack Engineer (Brazil) — TypeScript, Next.js, Node and
> Python, with AI as part of the engineering workflow. Builds critical web applications:
> sensitive integrations, precise validation and fast delivery.

## Focus

- Full Stack: TypeScript/React/Next.js, Node.js/NestJS/Express, Python, Java/Spring
- AI Engineering: LLM agents, subagents, project-specific rules and skills, MCP servers
- LLM integrations (OpenAI, Claude), prompt engineering, validation of AI-generated code
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Prisma, Drizzle
- Cloud: AWS (Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, Amplify, CloudFront), Docker, CI/CD

## Selected work

- Financial Backoffice (SAQ Digital) — B2B payment infrastructure backoffice built
  from scratch in under 3 months by a two-person team, replacing the legacy system.
  10M+ PIX transactions/day, R$1B+/month, clients in 3+ countries, 50+ integrated
  endpoints. https://saq.digital/
- 360° E-commerce Platform (Goatcom) — Shopify-like management platform, 10+ stores
  in production, 17+ integrations across ads, ERP, payments, invoicing and shipping.
  https://www.goatcom.io/global
- Socioeconomic Assessment (PUC Rio) — took over a project stalled for 6 months and
  shipped it to production in under 2, serving all enrolled students and 25+ staff.
